#### CreateServiceClientAsync

```text
public System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<Microsoft.PowerPlatform.Dataverse.Client.ServiceClient> CreateServiceClientAsync(System.String environmentUrl, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, System.Boolean forceInteractive = false)
```

Creates an authenticated ServiceClient for the specified environment URL.

- Parameter `environmentUrl`: The Dataverse environment URL.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.
- Parameter `forceInteractive`: If true, skip silent auth and prompt user directly. Use for profile creation.

Returns: An authenticated ServiceClient.

#### GetCachedTokenInfoAsync

```text
public System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.CachedTokenInfo> GetCachedTokenInfoAsync(System.String environmentUrl, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Gets cached token information without triggering interactive authentication. Queries the MSAL token cache to determine current token state.

- Parameter `environmentUrl`: The Dataverse environment URL to check token for.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Returns: Token information if a valid cached token exists, null if token is expired or not cached.
